svg.text: Household / resident data; RBI; migration events
SB-ISPGM / RBIM - Level 1 Data Flow Diagram
Municipality of Tomas Oppus | Core business processes | Municipal DILG
Notation: rectangle = external entity; rounded rectangle = process; parallel lines = data store; arrow = data flow.
Repeated E and D identifiers refer to the same entities and stores. Stores include related database records and protected files.
Core business flows are shown. Authentication, activity logging and email transport details are omitted for readability.
